mobile.common.back.note: Affordance label of a text button that returns to the previous screen. A verb used as a label, no final full stop. LIMIT: navigation only; never 'undo', never a step back inside a form, and never used where the destination is named (a button saying 'Back to the library' is its own string).

mobile.common.cancel.note: Aborts the current sheet or form without saving; a verb used as a label, no final full stop. LIMIT: never the confirm action of a destructive dialog and never a dialog's 'keep it' choice that needs its own wording; screens with different intent use their own key.

mobile.common.done.note: Closes a sheet whose choices already applied as the user made them; nothing is submitted by pressing it. A verb used as a label, no final full stop. LIMIT: not a save or submit action, which is 'Save'.

mobile.common.save.note: Commits the edits made in the current sheet or form. A verb used as a label, no final full stop. LIMIT: says nothing about where it is saved or whether it is reversible; screens that must say so (for example a draft saved to one computer) use their own key.

mobile.common.send.note: Sends the message the user has typed in the adjacent composer. A verb used as a label, no final full stop. LIMIT: a message to an agent, not a file transfer or a share; do not translate with a word meaning 'post publicly' or 'upload'.

mobile.common.try_again.note: Re-runs the action that just failed, next to the error that reported it. An imperative used as a label, no final full stop. LIMIT: a retry of a failed read or write; never a reset and never a restart of the app or the connection.

mobile.common.not_found.title.note: Header title of the screen shown for a route that does not exist. No final full stop.

mobile.common.not_found.headline.note: Empty-state headline on the not-found screen. Sentence with a final full stop.

mobile.common.not_found.next.note: Empty-state follow-up on the not-found screen, pointing to the session list. One sentence.

mobile.common.not_found.action.note: Button on the not-found screen that goes to the session list. Short, no final full stop.

mobile.common.copy.note: Small button beside a command the reader runs on their computer (own-tunnel and Radient set-up screens): copies the command to the clipboard. One word, no final full stop.

mobile.common.copied.note: The same button's label right after the copy succeeded. One word, no final full stop.

mobile.common.copy_command_hint.note: Screen-reader hint on the Copy button beside a command block. {label} is the block's own label, already translated (e.g. "Install on the computer") or a product name ("Cloudflare", "ngrok"). No final full stop.
